autoGenerated.description: DEPRECATED: no longer consulted. Auto-generation is now implicit whenever modules.sql.tls.enabled is true and modules.sql.tls.certificatesSecret is empty. Slated for removal in the next major bump.

DEPRECATED: no longer consulted. The EAP tls-config leaf is now auto-generated implicitly whenever modules.eap.enabled is true and modules.eap.tlsConfig.certificates_secret is empty. Slated for removal in the next major bump.

users.description: RADIUS users for the `files` module, in declaration order. Each entry needs name + password; optional passwordType / attributes / reply.

autoGenerated.description: DEPRECATED: no longer consulted. RADSEC TLS material is now auto-generated implicitly whenever tls.enabled is true and tls.certificatesSecret / tls.existingSecretName are empty (mechanism: cert-manager when its API is detected, otherwise genCA). Slated for removal in the next major bump.

create.description: DEPRECATED: no longer consulted. The chart now uses cert-manager whenever its API is detected; to opt out of cert-manager issuance for this release, pre-create a Secret and point tls.certificatesSecret at it. Slated for removal in the next major bump.

infrastructure.description: Optional Gateway data-plane infrastructure extension. Allowed values: "" (none) or "envoy" (renders an EnvoyProxy CR and attaches it to the chart's Gateway via spec.infrastructure.parametersRef). Only applicable when implementation: gateway-api.

envoyProxy.description: EnvoyProxy ownership knobs, consumed when gateway.infrastructure: envoy. {create, name} mirrors gateway.gateway.*: create=true renders the chart's EnvoyProxy, create=false references an externally-managed one by name.
